_basis_key.cost: hospital's own cost of care (HCUP converts charges to cost with cost-to-charge ratios); not what anyone pays
_basis_key.paid: allowed/paid amount = insurer payment + patient cost-sharing (commercial claims unless noted)
_basis_key.charged: billed list price; far above what is actually paid

hospital_stay.source: AHRQ HCUP Statistical Brief #316 (aggregate cost) + HCUP NIS 2022 Weighted Summary Statistics (mean LOS)
hospital_stay.arithmetic: SB316: $548.5B aggregate cost / 32.9M stays = $16,672 per stay. NIS 2022 weighted mean LOS = 5.1778 days. $16,672 / 5.18 = $3,220 per day. HCUP does not publish this per-stay mean directly in SB316; it is derived from its two published aggregates.

charged_equivalent.source: HCUP NIS 2022 Weighted Summary Statistics, mean TOTCHG

commercial.source: HCCI 2022 Health Care Cost and Utilization Report (average price of an inpatient admission, employer-sponsored insurance; facility component)
commercial.note: Facility price only; professional (doctor) fees during the stay are counted separately by HCCI. Average facility out-of-pocket was $1,074.

broken_arm_er.year_note: MarketScan claims 2007-2016; dollar year not stated in abstract
broken_arm_er.source: Shapiro et al., J Hand Microsurg 2023 (IBM MarketScan): utilization cost of nonoperatively treated distal radius fracture, patients 55+, no later malunion surgery; reported as $2,209 +/- $5,940
broken_arm_er.note: Not ER-specific (covers the nonoperative fracture episode wherever treated) and limited to age 55+. Proxy: HCCI 2021 average commercial price of an ER visit including all services was $2,909 (see er_visit).

broken_arm_surgery.year_note: Truven MarketScan claims 2009-2015; dollar year not stated in abstract
broken_arm_surgery.source: Huetteman, Zhong, Chung, J Hand Surg Am 2018 (Truven MarketScan): surgical distal radius fracture episode, 88% open fixation; average $6,577 to $8,181 depending on episode definition
broken_arm_surgery.note: Range is as published, not averaged here. Episode = 3 days pre-op to 90 days post-op. 15% of patients were 65+ (Medicare supplemental included). Outpatient vs inpatient not separated in the abstract.

er_visit.source: HCCI, Emergency Room Spending, Price, and Use Trends 2012-2021 (average price of an ER visit including all services, commercial)
er_visit.note: E&M (exam) portion alone, facility + professional, was $1,317. Peterson-KFF (MarketScan, large employer, 2019): $2,453 per ED visit excluding any subsequent hospitalization; $646 average out-of-pocket.

urgent_care.source: HCCI, Urgent Care Spending Increased by 50% over 5 Years (average price per urgent care visit, employer-sponsored insurance)

office_visit.source: Peterson-KFF Health System Tracker, Outpatient visits billed at increasingly higher levels (average E&M cost in outpatient physician offices, established patients, all levels)
office_visit.note: Physician office E&M, not specifically primary care. Older Peterson-KFF figure: level-3 office visit $90 allowed (2018).

mri.source: Peterson-KFF Health System Tracker, How costly are common health services (lower-back MRI, average allowed, large employer plans, MarketScan)
mri.note: Lower-back MRI only; metro range $404 (Las Vegas) to $1,106 (Houston).

knee_arthroscopy.source: Peterson-KFF Health System Tracker, How costly are common health services (outpatient meniscus repair, average allowed, large employer plans, MarketScan)
knee_arthroscopy.note: Meniscus repair is an arthroscopic knee procedure; not a general 'all knee arthroscopy' average. Metro range $4,655 (Detroit) to $11,219 (NYC).

heart_attack.source: Peterson-KFF Health System Tracker, How costly are common health services (heart attack hospitalization, average allowed, large employer plans)
heart_attack.days_source: Bhat et al., Medicina 2022, HCUP NIS 2000-2017 pooled: mean 5 +/- 5.8 days, median 3 days
heart_attack.note: LOS is a pooled 2000-2017 mean, not a single recent year; recent stays are shorter (a 2019 NIS study reports adjusted LOS 3.95 days for survivors).

hcup_cost.source: HCUP SB316 Table 1: AMI $16,332M aggregate / 582K stays

hcci_circulatory_2022.source: HCCI 2022 HCCUR, average price of a circulatory admission (broader than heart attack)

cancer_first_year.source: Mariotto et al., Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev 2020 (NCI, SEER-Medicare): initial-phase annualized cancer-attributable cost, medical care $41,800 + oral drugs $1,800, 2019 dollars
cancer_first_year.note: Medicare-paid amounts for patients 65+, cancer-attributable (net of matched controls), all sites combined; commercial prices are typically higher. HCCI 2022: average commercial price of one cancer inpatient admission was $64,750.

gaps: No HCUP Statistical Brief publishes a 2022 all-stays mean cost per stay directly; hospital_stay cost is derived from SB316 aggregates (arithmetic shown).
No national source found for a broken arm treated specifically in the ER with X-ray + cast; the figure used is a MarketScan nonoperative distal radius fracture episode for patients 55+ (2007-2016).
Broken arm surgery figure is 2009-2015 claims and does not separate outpatient from inpatient ORIF; no FAIR Health or HCCI figure for outpatient ORIF found.
No recent (2022+) single-year national mean LOS for heart attack found from HCUP; used 2000-2017 pooled NIS mean.

MRI and knee arthroscopy figures are 2018 Peterson-KFF (lower-back MRI; meniscus repair) - no newer national commercial average located. FAIR Health charges data is behind its consumer lookup and was not used.
Office visit figure is all physician-office E&M (2021), not primary care specifically.
Cancer first-year cost is Medicare 65+ (2019 dollars); no national commercial first-year figure located.
